domains.title: Domains
domains.intro: The domains this server accepts mail for.

empty.title: No domain yet
empty.body: Add the domain this server should receive mail for.

create.title: Add domain
create.name: Domain
create.hint: The domain must be yours. The DNS records it needs come in the next step.

detail.dnsIntro: Your DNS provider needs these records. After a change, just check again.
detail.neverChecked: Not checked yet. The check takes a few seconds.
detail.sourceResolver: Outgoing DNS is blocked here, so the server's resolver answered. New records may show up a little later.
detail.upstream: Mail for this domain arrives through an upstream mail server, so the MX record may point to it.
detail.relay: Outgoing mail leaves through {{relay}}. SPF must allow that server.
detail.name: Name
detail.nameHint: Some DNS providers want only the part before {{domain}} as the name.

purpose.mx: Tells other mail servers where mail for this domain goes.
purpose.spf: Says which servers may send on behalf of the domain.
purpose.dmarc: Tells recipients what to do with forged mail.
purpose.dkim: Public key recipients use to check the signature of your mail.

notes.mxUpstream: Points to the upstream mail server. That's fine.
notes.mxElsewhere: Points to another server, so mail will not arrive here.
notes.spfTooLoose: Allows any server to send. Better end it with -all.
notes.spfMultiple: There are several SPF records. Only one is allowed.
notes.spfNotAllowed: Does not allow the sending server. Mail then often lands in spam.
notes.spfUnverified: The address of the sending server could not be found.
notes.dmarcNone: Policy “none”: good for testing. Later switch to quarantine or reject.
notes.dmarcInvalid: The policy (p=) is missing or invalid.
notes.dmarcMultiple: There are several DMARC records. Only one is allowed.
notes.lookupFailed: The lookup failed. Try again in a moment.

detail.catchAllHint: Mail to addresses that don't exist goes to this person. It also attracts more spam.
detail.keysIntro: The server signs every outgoing mail with these. Switching to new keys now and then is good practice.
detail.rotateSteps: Add the new records above at your DNS provider, check them, then switch over. The old keys keep working until then.
detail.retiredHint: Keep retired keys in DNS for a few days until all mail has been delivered, then remove them.
detail.removeHint: Only possible when no address uses the domain anymore.

empty.title: Nothing is waiting
empty.body: All mail is on its way or delivered.

queue.dropConfirm: Delete message #{{id}} without notifying the sender?

toasts.retry: Will be retried in a moment

logs.intro: The newest lines of the server log, live.
logs.unavailable: This server keeps no logs for the admin panel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: For the whole server. Changes take effect at once, without a restart.
settings.fileNote: Whatever {{file}} or UWUMAIL_* environment variables set takes precedence and is locked here.
settings.envNote: Whatever UWUMAIL_* environment variables set takes precedence and is locked here.

tone.title: Mail from the server
tone.intro: Notices about undeliverable mail and automatic replies.
tone.internalHint: Mail to people on this server.
tone.externalHint: Mail to everyone else, e.g. when a message cannot be delivered.

delivery.title: Sending
delivery.intro: How mail leaves for other servers.
delivery.directHint: The server delivers to the recipients' mail servers itself. Port 25 must be open and the IP must have a good reputation.
delivery.relayHint: Everything goes through another mail server, e.g. when your connection blocks port 25.
delivery.passwordSet: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
delivery.requireTlsHint: Servers without encryption get no mail. Safer, but some recipients become unreachable.
delivery.lifetimeHint: How long the server keeps retrying before the sender gets a notice.

receiving.title: Receiving
receiving.intro: Limits and checks for incoming mail.
receiving.enforceDmarcHint: Mail that breaks the sender's policy is refused instead of going to spam.
receiving.trustedRelaysHint: IP addresses or networks, one per line. UwUMail does their sender checks.

apps.title: Mail apps
apps.intro: Login and privacy when sending from apps.
apps.revealIp: Show the IP address in sent mail
apps.revealIpHint: By default UwUMail does not reveal where someone sent a message from.

health.notChecked: The first check runs shortly after the start.

findings.dnsOk_one: The domain is set up correctly.
findings.dnsOk_other: All {{count}} domains are set up correctly.
findings.dnsPending_one: One domain has not been checked yet.
findings.dnsPending_other: {{count}} domains have not been checked yet.
findings.dnsUnavailable: DNS cannot be checked because the server cannot resolve names.
findings.certWaiting: The Let's Encrypt certificate has not arrived yet.
findings.deliveryNotChecked: Not checked yet whether mail can leave.
findings.outboundBlocked: The server cannot reach other mail servers ({{count}} domains affected).
findings.port25Blocked: Outgoing port 25 seems to be blocked.
findings.probeDns: The sending check could not resolve names.
findings.queueStuck_one: One message has been stuck for {{since}}.
findings.queueStuck_other: {{count}} messages are stuck, the oldest for {{since}}.
findings.manyBounces: {{count}} of {{total}} messages in the last 24 hours were refused.

hints.noDomains: Without a domain the server cannot receive mail.
hints.dnsDomain: The domain page shows which record is missing or wrong.
hints.certWaiting: The server must be reachable under its name on port 80. Until then mail apps warn when connecting.
hints.certSelfSigned: Mail apps warn when connecting. For real use, use Let's Encrypt or your own certificate files.
hints.certWrongName: Mail apps warn when connecting. Check the hostname in the configuration.
hints.certExpired: Mail apps can no longer connect securely. Renew the certificate.
hints.certExpiresSoon: It is usually renewed in time. The log shows why that fails.
hints.relayLogin: Check the username and password under Settings → Sending.
hints.relayTls: Check the port and encryption under Settings → Sending.
hints.relayUnreachable: Check the relay's address and port. Mail waits in the queue meanwhile.
hints.outboundBlocked: Many internet connections block port 25. A relay under Settings → Sending helps then.
hints.port25Blocked: Many internet connections block port 25. A relay under Settings → Sending helps then.
hints.queueStuck: The queue shows what is going wrong.
hints.manyBounces: Other servers refuse mail, e.g. because of SPF, DKIM or the IP address's reputation.
hints.diskLow: When storage is full, the server cannot accept mail any more.
hints.mailboxesNearlyFull: Full mailboxes stop accepting mail. Raise the limit or ask them to clean up.
